settings.notification_banner.description: Custom PNG/JPG for the notification banner. Empty uses the bundled art.
settings.notification_sound.description: WAV/OGG/MP3 played when a notification appears. Empty uses the bundled paper sound.
settings.music_banner.description: Background art for the music widget. Empty uses the bundled banner.
settings.music_character_frame.description: Portrait frame for the music widget. Empty uses the bundled Futaba/Sumire frame.
settings.music_character_name.description: Name tag text. Empty keeps the name from the selected asset.
settings.calendar_assets_dir.description: Folder containing Day, Month, Week, ToD and Weather. Empty uses the bundled calendar.
settings.wallpaper_auto_enabled.description: Switch between day, afternoon and night wallpapers using the sunrise/sunset timeline.
settings.wallpaper_day.description: Used for morning/daytime. Empty uses assets/p5wallpaper/p5cityday.png.
settings.wallpaper_afternoon.description: Used from noon to dusk. Empty uses assets/p5wallpaper/p5cityafternoon.png.
settings.wallpaper_night.description: Used from dusk to sunrise. Empty uses assets/p5wallpaper/p5citynight.png.
settings.notification_font.description: TTF/OTF used for the notification title. Empty uses Persona5main.ttf.
settings.ui_font.description: TTF/OTF used for notification body and music UI text. Empty uses PersonifiedUXRegular.ttf.
settings.music_font.description: TTF/OTF used for the Jitter music buttons. Empty uses personafont.ttf.
settings.respect_noctalia_dnd.description: When Noctalia DND is on, suppress Persona 5 banners and notification sound.
